Note: Connect the red (+) and black (-) terminals from each speaker to the corresponding banana plugs and terminals on Amp. | 1 | Make sure your speakers are compatible with Amp:    Your speakers’ power rating should be at least 125W for 8 ohm speakers, and at least 200W for 4 ohm speakers. Do not connect speakers rated at less than 4 ohm.  Amp can drive speakers with nominal impedance above 4 ohms. Two pairs of 8 ohm speakers wired in parallel are also supported. Don’t wire your speakers in series because it will result in poor sound quality. |
